text: D237665 reviewers prefer making registerWindow manage or wait for readiness. The author asks to land the caller-load changes urgently and adds a defensive guard; the final reviewer accepts that scope while explicitly retaining future API work. The fixed manager rejects duplicates and rejects a loading window only while osValue is unset, then tracks unload and applies the value. Search registers in searchOnLoad. Existing73c3445954a70703fb6a4b26f0060f542b8469e2f05703089a992d12efec4e90 describes that actual caller contract. Acceptance did not implement automatic waiting or withdraw the preferred API improvement. Calendar dialog coverage loss and lazy-import flicker are author-reported scoped tradeoffs, not global API/import rules. No font or readiness test ran.
title: UIFontSize accepted an urgent caller fix while deferring API readiness
